title: 15 Best Marketing Apps for Small Business: 2026 List (Free + Paid)

facts.fact: Buffer's pricing starts at $6/month per channel, according to the page.
facts.quote: Buffer’s pricing starts at $6/month per channel.

facts.fact: Later offers a free tier, and its paid plans start at $18/month for one social set.
facts.quote: Pricing:** Free tier available; paid plans start at $18/month for one social set.

facts.fact: Hootsuite starts at $99/month for one user and three social accounts.
facts.quote: Starts at $99/month for one user and three social accounts

facts.fact: Mailchimp offers a free plan for up to 500 contacts, and its paid plans start at $13/month.
facts.quote: Free up to 500 contacts; paid plans start at $13/month.

facts.fact: Mailchimp's free tier covers up to 500 contacts.
facts.quote: It offers a generous free tier (up to 500 contacts)

facts.fact: Hootsuite integrates with over 150 tools, including CRM systems, content creation tools, and customer service platforms.
facts.quote: It integrates with over 150 tools including CRM systems, content creation tools, and customer service platforms.

facts.fact: The page says Hootsuite is best suited to small businesses with dedicated social media teams of 3 or more people.
facts.quote: Small businesses with dedicated social media teams (3+ people) managing multiple brand accounts.

facts.fact: The page's evaluation criteria exclude any tool that requires more than 30 minutes of onboarding to do something basic.
facts.quote: If a tool requires more than 30 minutes of onboarding to do something basic, it did not make this list.

facts.fact: The page states that its pricing reflects publicly available information as of April 2026.
facts.quote: All pricing noted reflects publicly available information as of April 2026.

facts.fact: The article was last modified on June 17, 2026.
